subject: Packages for working with MODIS NDVI data?

messages.author: 4dee24c578d7691c
messages.subject: Packages for working with MODIS NDVI data?
parts:
Hey all,

I'm curious if anyone has some recent experience working with NDVI (from
MODIS) data in R. Specifically, I am looking for a package that helps
streamline the process of downloading NDVI for several years in a few
select locations across a large spatial extent. In the past I would have
laboriously downloaded dozens of hdf files from Earth Explorer, than
reprojected those files, then mosiaced the files and extracted values
for my locations of interest. However, there appear to be some R
packages out there that help with this process, so I am wondering if any
of you have experience with those, and which you would recommend!

Thanks in advance!
Stella

--
Stella Copeland
Post-doctoral Researcher
Harrison Lab, Plant Ecology
UC Davis

Hi Stella, 

I haven't used any of the MODIS access tools through R. I'd used some similar tools from Ropensci, and thought they might have a MODIS one, but looks like no dice. In googling I found some tutorials (below) that I thought I may as well pass along. 

First one looks pretty useful. Both use MODIS and/or MODISTools packages
